import_provenance.original_title: A linear bound in the flatness theorem
import_provenance.original_statement: Is the lattice width of every convex body in ℝⁿ whose interior contains no integer point at most Cn for a universal constant C? Here lattice width is the minimum, over nonzero integer vectors a, of maxₓaᵀx−minₓaᵀx; a linear bound would sharpen a basic geometric ingredient of integer programming.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: This is a broader geometric target extending the authors’ flatness bounds for polyhedra; the known near-linear bound does not establish O(n).
